musical_contract.foreground_identity: Robi remains recognizable as the foreground voice and recurring hook.
musical_contract.loop_behavior: The same thirty-second object must remain pleasant and structurally complete under uninterrupted repetition.
musical_contract.band_rule: The band must be one coherent performed organism from an admitted local provider or a source-coherent crate/rack construction.
musical_contract.timing_rule: Use the measured timing of the selected rhythm body. A requested BPM is never timing authority.
musical_contract.arrangement_rule: Variation must come from performance, subtraction, event placement, and source interaction, not from adding generic genre signifiers.
musical_contract.machine_triage: Provider probes, engineering renders, and weak candidates remain machine-side. Only one complete candidate may enter owner review.

requirements: exact model and codec asset identities
sealed generation request and observed execution receipt
private binding to the exact Robi source
exact beat, transcription, harmonization, generator, and codec asset identities
sealed generation request and observed execution receipt
private binding to the exact Robi source
one source-coherent kit/bass body rather than unrelated one-shots
exact atom, source, rack, binding, MIDI or MixScore, and render receipts

inadmissible_objects: multiple variants sharing one dominant defect
owner_admission.state_change_on_accept: The Robi WHOA loop commission has an accepted production candidate.
owner_admission.state_change_on_reject: The selected production mechanism closes; the source and commission remain available to another admitted mechanism.
